title: crepidomanes plicatum
intro: Crepidomanes plicatum, commonly known as the folded fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepidomanes plicatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that may help to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Crepidomanes plicatum for medicinal use, but it has shown promise as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
